extends SceneTree

func _init() -> void:
    var res_paths = [
        "res://resources/enemies/goblin.tres",
        "res://resources/enemies/orc.tres",
        "res://resources/enemies/dragon.tres"
    ]
    var stats = []
    for p in res_paths:
        var res = load(p)
        if not res:
            push_error("Failed to load: " + p)
            continue
        if res.get_script() != preload("res://scripts/EnemyStats.gd"):
            push_error(p + " is not EnemyStats: " + str(res))
            continue
        print(p, " -> ", res.name, " | hp=", res.max_health, " | sp=", res.speed, " | dmg=", res.damage, " | color=", res.color)
        stats.append(res)

    if stats.size() != 3:
        push_error("Only " + str(stats.size()) + "/3 enemy resources loaded")
    else:
        # Verify pairwise distinctness (tracked set per attribute)
        var seen_hp = {}; var seen_sp = {}; var seen_dmg = {}; var seen_col = {}; var seen_name = {}
        var distinct = true
        for s in stats:
            for container in [seen_name, seen_hp, seen_sp, seen_dmg, seen_col]:
                var val
                if container == seen_name: val = s.name
                elif container == seen_hp: val = s.max_health
                elif container == seen_sp: val = s.speed
                elif container == seen_dmg: val = s.damage
                else: val = s.color
                if val in container:
                    push_error("Duplicate value found: " + str(val))
                    distinct = false
                container[val] = true
        if distinct:
            print("OK: All 3 enemy resources have pairwise distinct values.")
        else:
            push_error("Duplicate values detected!")

    print("Test complete.")
    quit()
